Subject: Westrow Grill Holdings - Quote Request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the submission on Westrow Grill Holdings! I've reviewed the information and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I do have a few questions before I can finalize pricing:

- Can you confirm the primary cooking operations at each location (grills, fryers, etc.) and verify all hood suppression systems are up to code?
- Are both locations sprinklered throughout?
- Any plans for expansion or renovations in the next 12 months?
- Can you provide details on any losses from the past five years that exceeded $10K?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for you. Looking forward to hearing back!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
